messages:
Mia (CSM): Heads-up — Oceancrest dedicated bring-up tomorrow 09:00 PT. Quota committed: 20 reserved GPUs across 2 pools, target steady qps ~8k, burst to 18k. Need final signoff on autoscale policy + load test window. Can everyone confirm ops timeline?
Sam (SRE): I can run the load tests. Proposed window: 09:00–11:00 PT, steady 45m @8k then 30m burst profiles. Script: `./tools/loadgen --profile oceancrest-steady --qps 8000 --duration 2700` then bursts with `--profile burst-peak`. Will stream logs to #eng-sre.
Carlos (SE): I'll handle priming: prefix cache + KV warmup. Plan: run `rbw-prime --type=prefix --shard=all --concurrency=50` 30m before the steady run. That cuts first-token p95 by ~35% from our last bakeoff.
Mia (CSM): @Sam @Carlos please confirm we have 1.2x headroom reserved for autoscale and a fallback to hosted-api if slot shortage triggers. Also we need billing ops to temporarily bump quota for the test.
Sam (SRE): Confirmed on headroom. Autoscale proposal: min_replicas=2, target_util=0.65, max_replicas=24 (to allow burst headroom), scale_up_window=60s, scale_down_delay=600s. Fallback policy: route overflow to hosted model variant redwood-hosted/rc-small.
Carlos (SE): +1. Also recommend enabling KV persistence on pool A (for long contexts) and force a cold-start test after warmup to validate fallback behavior. I'll add a small test that kills one instance mid-burst to validate graceful fallback.
Priya (PM): Two product asks: 1) capture p50/p95/p99 latency and error rate per-route (not just per-pool) so we can scope any perf regressions; 2) capture model output quality sample (10K prompts) during steady and burst to run quick evals — want to flag any tokenization/regression early.
Mia (CSM): Good call. I'll coordinate the quality sample set with Oceancrest SREs before 08:30 PT. Also scheduling enablement call for 14:00 PT to walk their infra folks through failover and billing.
Sam (SRE): Monitoring knobs: watch `inference.tokens_per_sec`, `serving.cpu_pct`, `gpu_mem_free_mb`, `kv_cache_hits`. Alert thresholds: p95 latency > 300ms OR error rate > 0.5% => page. I'll post Grafana dashboards link in a minute.
Carlos (SE): Runbook snippet I'll use for priming and load:
```
# priming
./rbw-prime --template oceancrest-prefix.json --parallel 40 --duration 1800
# load
./tools/loadgen --profile oceancrest-steady --qps 8000 --duration 2700 --report ./reports/oceancrest_steady.json
```
Mia (CSM): Deploy-billing update: finance confirmed temporary quota increase for the test window; they'll reconcile with the account later. Also renewal touchpoint: if warmup shows stable cost/profile we'll mark renewal low-risk; I'll capture notes on the 14:00 call.
deploy-bot: canary-deploy/redwood-runtime v2.13.1 -> success :white_check_mark:
Sam (SRE): small log example to watch for (token cache miss flood):
```
2026-03-20T16:10:12Z WARN kv_cache miss rate 0.42 scope=prefix shard=3
2026-03-20T16:10:13Z INFO backpressure applied target_qps 8200 current_replica 8
```
Mia (CSM): Action items:
- Sam: run load tests 09:00–11:00 PT, stream logs to #eng-sre and ping me on failures.
- Carlos: run priming 30m before steady window, run kill/fallback test during burst.
- Priya: prepare quality evaluation script + 10K prompt set by 08:30 PT.
- Mia: host enablement + renewal sync at 14:00 PT, capture feedback in CS tracker.
Carlos (SE): I'll also prepare a short checklist for the ops handoff (GPU IDs, KMS keys, pool names, autoscale knobs). Posting in thread in 10m. :thumbsup:
Sam (SRE): I'll attach the load profiles and expected dashboards after run. If we see sustained tail latencies >350ms we'll throttle burst and run a second controlled pass.
Mia (CSM): Thanks all — this thread will be the source of truth during the run. Ping me immediately if billing or keys fail.
deploy-bot: scheduled job: oceancrest-warmup-run -> queued for 2026-03-21T16:00:00Z
